_conventions.purpose: Ground truth for evaluation. Never edit this file to match model output.
_conventions.substance_ids: Substance keys from rohs_rules.py: lead, mercury, cadmium, chromium_vi, pbb, pbde, dehp, bbp, dbp, dibp.
_conventions.near_limit: NEAR_LIMIT when concentration >= 80% of the limit and <= the limit.
_conventions.unverifiable_vs_missing: UNVERIFIABLE when a value is given as text that cannot be compared to a limit (trace amounts, N/A, <LOD). MISSING_CONCENTRATION when no value is given at all.
_conventions.exemption: A substance with an exemption claim gets EXEMPTION_CLAIMED instead of OVER_LIMIT, so the declaration routes to human review (Medium) rather than High.
_conventions.risk_rating: Any OVER_LIMIT = High. Else any MISSING_CAS, MISSING_CONCENTRATION, UNVERIFIABLE or EXEMPTION_CLAIMED = Medium. Else NEAR_LIMIT only = Low with watch flag. Else Low.

05_veldra_ppm.csv.characteristic: Concentrations in ppm instead of % (all compliant once converted: lead 450 ppm = 0.045%)

06_corvan_cadmium_near.pdf.characteristic: Cadmium just under its stricter limit (0.009% vs 0.01%)
